thread:
Aisha: Heads up 1: someone left a small leak of maple syrup on the top pantry shelf. Found it when grabbing cereal. sticky :grimacing:
Tom: Yikes. I noticed a sticky streak on the rice bin yesterday but thought it was coffee. Will wipe it properly now.
Riley: Which bottle? the little travel maple or the refillable pump?
Aisha: Travel-sized amber bottle, white cap, behind the granola. Cap looks cross-threaded.
Ben: I pick it up but I rather not touch syrup with bare hands. Gloves and paper towels?
Lina: On it. I grabbed gloves + spray. Also can we start a tiny kitchen rule: "close lids"? Sounds dumb but helps.
Tom: Agreed. Also propose printed labels for shared dispensers (oat milk, syrup, vanilla). Handwriting gets gross.
Riley: I can make a 3-field template: Item | Opened | Reseal? and a bold END indicator for empties.
Aisha: Love the "END" cap idea. Saves the 2nd person who awkwardly tries to open a sticky jar.
kitchen-bot: Note: Kitchen tidy reminder scheduled Fridays @ 3pm.
Ben: Ooh can we get a small weekly snack run? volunteers rotate. Fridays make sense (snacks for the office weekend crew).
Lina: Count me in for the rotation. Also printing: clear shipping labels stick best.
Riley: Template posted in #office-resources: ```Shelf-Label
Item: _______
Opened: MM/DD
Reseal: YES / NO
EMPTY (if empty)```
Tom: I have a spare roll of labels in my desk. I'll leave it in the kitchen tonight.
Aisha: Brilliant. Also who nabbed the mini pancake syrup? I put it in the snack drawer and now it's gone. :eyes: 
Ben: Not me. People hide snacks in desk drawers, watch out.
Lina: Quick poll: weekly snack run on Fridays? :one: Yes :two: No
Aisha: :one:
Tom: :one:
Riley: :one:
Ben: :one:
Lina: Weekly run thumbs-up. I'll make a sign-up sheet and post it. Thanks team! :coffee:
